{
  "name": "limit-radar",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Your 5h/7d subscription limits, a burn-pace forecast and a cold-cache warning, shown above the prompt only when there is something to act on.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Daniil Bystrov",
    "url": "https://github.com/Jvrd97"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Jvrd97/claude-limit-radar",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Jvrd97/claude-limit-radar",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "usage",
    "rate-limits",
    "statusline",
    "cache"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "display": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where to show",
      "description": "auto shows a line above the prompt only when a window passes the first warn threshold, the pace runs out before the reset, or the cache is cold; band always shows the bars; status writes one line to the status line; both does band and status; off keeps only the toasts and /limits.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "band",
        "status",
        "both",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "warnAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Warn at (percent)",
      "description": "Comma-separated thresholds. A toast fires once per window and threshold, across sessions; in auto the line appears from the first one.",
      "default": "80,95"
    },
    "cacheTtlMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Cache lifetime (minutes)",
      "description": "After this much idle time the prompt cache is treated as cold and the band warns. 0 turns the warning off.",
      "default": 60
    }
  }
}
